title: List all game scenarios
description: Returns all game scenarios with their labels and root nodes.

title: List all players
description: Returns all players with their labels and descriptions.

title: List all decision nodes
description: Returns all decision nodes with the player who controls each one and the available actions.

title: List all chance nodes with probabilities
description: Returns all chance nodes and their outgoing actions with associated probabilities.

title: List all outcome nodes
description: Returns all terminal outcome nodes with their labels and descriptions.

title: Payoffs for each outcome
description: Returns the utility payoff for each player at each terminal outcome node.

title: All payoffs for a specific player
description: Returns all possible outcome payoffs grouped by player, ordered by utility value.

title: Best outcome for each player
description: Returns the outcome with the highest utility value for each player.

title: Worst outcome for each player
description: Returns the outcome with the lowest utility value for each player.

title: Full game tree traversal
description: Traverses the game tree showing nodes, actions, and the nodes they lead to.
query:
PREFIX gt: <http://trustgraph.ai/schemas/gametheory#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?fromNodeLabel ?actionLabel ?toNodeLabel
WHERE {
  ?fromNode gt:hasAction ?action .
  ?fromNode rdfs:label ?fromNodeLabel .
  ?action gt:actionLabel ?actionLabel ;
          gt:leadsToNode ?toNode .
  ?toNode rdfs:label ?toNodeLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?fromNodeLabel ?actionLabel

title: All actions with probabilities
description: Returns all actions that have an associated probability, indicating chance-driven outcomes.

title: Decision points per player
description: Returns a count of decision nodes controlled by each player.
